text: {"lessons":["Selling just because a position is above my average cost can cut short a good investment; cost basis alone is not a reason to sell.","I should evaluate each holding by its forward-looking risk and return in the context of the whole portfolio, not treat it as a separate account or cling to it to avoid admitting a mistake.","Because past price changes do not predict future moves, frequent checking and trading are not an edge; I should make deliberate decisions rather than react to short-term noise."]}
